item.title: No Kings turns its focus to voting this weekend. Here's what we know
item.description: The coalition behind nationwide anti-Trump protests is shifting its strategies this weekend to focus on voter turnout. Organizers say Saturday's events are a nonpartisan effort to get people to the polls.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
item.description: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Sajad Hameed for NPR)

item.title: Trump promised a swing district blitz. He's going to a lot of very red states
item.description: President Trump's midterm travel blitz ahead of Election Day includes several red states he won easily 2 years ago, showing the electoral landscape is more challenging for Republicans.

item.title: Coastal homes burn as hot winds fuel California fires
item.description: High winds are fueling a fast-moving fire that has burned homes in Southern California. Flames engulfed expensive coastal properties and prompted thousands to evacuate.
